title: Mechanistic Interpretability for Large Language Model Alignment: Progress, Challenges, and Future Directions

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing and proposing mechanistic interpretability methods such as comparative circuit analysis across languages and cultures, quantifying cultural representation diversity in model features, and measuring the causal impact of circuits that encode specific ethical frameworks (e.g., Western individualism versus collectivism).

Reviewing prior mechanistic interpretability studies that use circuit discovery, causal mediation analysis, and targeted ablation to identify and remove specific neural components (e.g., stereotype propagation heads) responsible for generating biased outputs.
